docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF SEP-08-2025 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF SEP-08-2025 BY JUDGE PRO TEM ERIC GROVER. PLAINTIFF EMAAN HARIRI APPEARED. NO APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT TREVOR ADAMS. PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM ERIC GROVER, CLERK: A. MOK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-08-2025 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HARIRI, EMAAN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT ADAMS, TREVOR $250.00 INTEREST, $200.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $450.00, DEFENDANT OWED PLAINTIFF $1750.00 FOR A LITTLE OVER TWO YEARS. DEFENDANT PAID $1,850.00 LAST WEEK. HOWEVER, THE ACCRUED INTEREST WAS $350.00. DEFENDANT THEREFORE OWES THE REMAINING $250.00 IN INTEREST AND $200 IN COSTS. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS, SEE JUDGMENT ATTACHED NO EXHIBITS FILED
REMARK:RETURNED MAIL FROM THE POST OFFICE. 09/16/2025. SC-130 NOTICE OF ENTRY OF JUDGMENT MAILED TO PLAINTIFF. (RETURN TO SENDER INSUFFICIENT ADDRESS UNABLE TO FORWARD)
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,750.00 FILED BY HARIRI, EMAAN AS TO DEFENDANT ADAMS, TREVOR ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-08-2025 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVICE FEE WAS $150.00 SERVED AUG-06-2025, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT ADAMS, TREVOR
STIPULATION FOR JUDGE PRO TEM FILED BY PLAINTIFF HARIRI, EMAAN
